formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 →     (∀ (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x3)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = (x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) →       (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 = fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x4 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) →         (∀ x5 ∈ [(4 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ)],             ∃! x7 : Fin (List.drop (1 : ℕ) x1.gates).length,               have x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := (List.drop (1 : ℕ) x1.gates).get x7;               x8.inputs[(0 : ℕ)]? = Option.some x5 ∨ x8.op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ x5 ∈ x8.inputs) →           (16 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges); a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for it whose first gate computes OR(x_4, x_6). If each of the inputs x_4 and x_6 is read by exactly one gate after the first, then the circuit has at least 16 gates.
